Name: Week 1 - Analysis / Advice
Notes: Weekly work window. Subtasks share the available time; bar length is not full-time effort.

Name: Set scope, requirements and project plan
Notes: Agree the one-plant scope, MoSCoW priorities and four-week plan. Complete the analysis and advice.

Name: Select technologies and collect parts
Notes: Finish technical choices. Check the ESP32, sensors, pump, OLED, power supply and any missing parts.

Name: Sketch wiring and system architecture
Notes: Draft the wiring and the connection between ESP32, MQTT, backend, database and dashboard.

Name: Week 2 - Design and prototypes
Notes: Weekly work window. Subtasks share the available time; bar length is not full-time effort.

Name: Design wiring, MQTT and database
Notes: Define pins, irrigation rules, MQTT messages, database tables and display content.

Name: Prototype sensors, irrigation and local display
Notes: Read sensors, show values on the OLED and try the pump with low-water protection.

Name: Test prototype and data connection
Notes: Check sensor readings and pump behaviour. Send a reading from the ESP32 through MQTT to the backend and database.

Name: Week 3 - Realization and testing
Notes: Weekly work window. Subtasks share the available time; bar length is not full-time effort.

Name: Complete firmware and backend
Notes: Finish local irrigation, fault handling and the Node.js backend. Keep essential device functions working without the server.

Name: Connect storage, dashboard and alerts
Notes: Connect PostgreSQL, Grafana, current readings, history, watering events and alerts.

Name: Test integration and update documents
Notes: Test the full system, record defects and update analysis, technical details or designs where implementation changed.

Name: Week 4 - Validation / Verification
Notes: Weekly work window. Subtasks share the available time; bar length is not full-time effort.

Name: Verify requirements and validate use
Notes: Check all Must Haves, pump safeguards, alerts and offline operation. Demonstrate that the system meets the user needs.

Name: Fix defects and repeat tests
Notes: Correct issues and repeat affected tests, including irrigation protection and the full data path.

Name: Finish documentation and submit
Notes: Complete the report and setup guidance. On the final day, recheck the corrected system, demonstrate it and submit.
